hook_text: R1 200 for a school fun day. Split it 40%, 25% and the rest — in your head.
clip_script: The fun day has a budget of R1 200. Forty percent is spent on food, twenty-five percent on prizes, and the rest on decorations. Food: forty percent of 1 200 is R480. Prizes: twenty-five percent is R300. Decorations: the remaining thirty-five percent, which is R420. Check: 480 plus 300 plus 420 is R1 200, and forty plus twenty-five plus thirty-five is one hundred percent.
visual_style: A R1 200 banknote bar splits into food, prize and decoration blocks; percentage labels and rand amounts pop in; the blocks rejoin to R1 200.
pacing: Brisk splits, pause on the remaining 35%, satisfying check.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to plan the whole fun day with fractions.
